# Foxhound

> A Windows-native Rust substrate for capturing and driving an application without taking the
> user's physical mouse, keyboard focus, foreground window, or visual z-order.

Foxhound provides primitives and a localhost helper. It is not an agent, workflow runner, recorder,
or adapter registry. Hound is the intended higher-level agent interface.

## Documentation

- [Project overview](README.md): Architecture, crate boundaries, build commands, and behavior.
- [Agent contribution guide](AGENTS.md): Invariants and verification requirements.
- [Helper source](crates/foxhound-helper/src): HTTP bridge and target lifecycle.

## Source

- [Public repository](https://github.com/csaben/foxhound): Canonical source and releases.
